summary: The CASE-03 routing test passed standalone but failed inside the formal runner because its simulated child smoke process inherited the real outer assertion-protocol owner identity.
root_cause: The routing-test harness copied SPECNAV_VERIFICATION_ASSERTION_PROTOCOL_OWNER_PID and the emitted state from process.env into its simulated run-smoke child. The child correctly refused to write another assertion result file, while the test incorrectly expected that isolated simulation to own and emit its temporary assertion records.
